verdictStatement: REJECT at 1 blocker and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The artifact's provenance and refusals are sound: all three cited digests match, every verbatim carry is exact against the live DR-G12 row, all seven members are present with both fields, the twelve FC classes are held unauthored, the D9 value half is correctly deferred to DR-007, purge is correctly held outside the specification with DR-113's wholesale deferral verified, CA-1 process-tree containment is routed to G21 as the live G21 corpus supports, required-now is unmoved, and closure of OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC is conditioned on ACCEPT and recording rather than on this file existing. It fails on EV-6. FC-REMEDIATION is the one class doctor-contract.v4 places outside both the quoted cell and the DR-114 source pin, derived from a candidate that binds NOTHING, and its own failsIf forbids the very bytes EV-6 names while DR-114 or DR-103 is open — both are live-OPEN. The subject imports it as retained evidence for the live member 'audit' with neither the derivation flag nor the dependency carried, in an artifact that applies exactly that disclosure pattern correctly three times elsewhere. A harness specification cannot list a supplier for a live member whose named bytes may not exist.
